rows.en: Sharl: "First, allow me to congratulate you on your return, Doctor."
Debish: "Yes. On this day, 109 years later,
we have all gathered together again.
This must surely be called providence."
Lyle: "Though we're short a few people."
I too regret what happened to Wenimas.
But there is something we must accomplish for the sake of this world.
To do so, we cannot afford to lose anyone else.
Debish: "Good. I am relieved to hear it."
Bernst: "Excuse me. I apologize for being late."
Debish: "Bernst... Have you aged a little?"
Well, that did give me time to think about many things."
Debish: "...Oh? I look forward to hearing them."
Debish: "...Surely you have something else to do
your proud creation is as it always was."
you were the one who 'sent her out,' as I recall?"
Debish: "I did not want a human being.
I believe I ordered you to create a tool.
And yet you gave it such unnecessary things as emotions..."
I shall be careful from now on."
Debish: "I am not asking for your opinion.
I am asking for a report."
Debish: "Have it installed in the Eleana.
I do not like the look in that thing's eyes."
Bernst: "But whether she can withstand the mental strain
is still something I cannot guarantee."
Debish: "It does not matter. If it breaks, we can make another."
Bernst: "I have no objection to that, but..."
Sharl: "...Doctor, about our plans from here..."
Debish: "...Yes. We could begin the 'activation' immediately,
but this time, we cannot fail as we did before.
Let us wait a little longer for the time to be ripe."
Debish: "Yes. The synchronization between that boy, Touya,
and the Rayblade is indeed remarkable.
But I can hardly call it sufficient."
Bernst: "And I do not imagine he would cooperate with us."
If he won't cooperate, we just force him into a position
With my Goderius to guide things, there should be no problem.
But that will be a little later.
Until then, let us give foolish humanity time
to surrender itself to fleeting pleasures..."
Bernst: "But we are part of that humanity as well.
Debish: "Quite right. But we are different
from the fools whose only ability
is to enjoy what they are given.
And we possess the 'power' to free people
they fear being inferior to others
and come to hate those who surpass them. Is that it?"
Debish: "As long as people remain individuals,
that is an immutable truth that will endure for eternity."
Bernst: "You have not changed, Dr. Debish."
Sharl: "...Bernst, this is no time for debate.
Even as we proceed with preparations for activation,
we have no time to sit and wait.
Doctor. I suggest we go to them once more."
In my view, his growth has been remarkable,
and he has already reached a stage where activation can be prompted.
Therefore, I propose taking a hostage
Is she really worth that much?"
Bernst: "I reached that conclusion while traveling with them.
They have a very strong sense of camaraderie,
so she will make excellent bait to draw him out."
Well, either way, I'll pass on that sort of thing.
Bernst: "Do you trust me so little?"
Sharl: "Have you done something to lose our trust?"
Very well. Shall we make this a joint operation?
It is true, we have no time. We must summon it quickly,
Whew, I slept well... Now, how long has it been...
One, ten, a hundred... F-Four thousand years?!
...Hmm... Perhaps I overslept a little... Hmm?"
No, it is different. I see. So that one has finally awakened..."
I suppose I should go wake them..."
Adjutant: "...It was officially announced a short while ago."
Growster: "Do you think you can just die...
and run off with the victory from that match...?
Growster: "Heh, hehehe... Right to the end... Grr..."
Adjutant: "Your Excellency... There is one more thing..."
Growster: "The elector cities have dispatched their armies?"
Adjutant: "Yes. At present, Crown Prince Lodis is negotiating
with the cities in the king's place."
Growster: "We cannot let this drag on any longer..."
Growster: "...Perhaps I should take the field too..."
Horem: "I see... Perhaps we shall have to
It seems Cain failed in the end as well..."
Vales: "We are ready whenever you are."
And do be sure to treat the person courteously."
Vales: "I understand. I'll do the work specified in the contract."
Horem: "I am counting on you, Sir 'Crimson Knight.'"
Jono: "...He knows about your past, Commander...
Vales: "It doesn't matter. It is in the past, after all.
We make our living by completing jobs.
Let's finish this quickly and collect our pay."
Vales: "True. All right, let's review the operation..."
Sisk: "We will arrive at the Holy Land shortly."
Ai: "It feels like it's been ages."
Kururu: "Wow... So this is the Holy Land..."
Ymir: "Is this your first time here?"
Kururu: "Yes. It's my first time outside Zigrim.
The only city I've been to is Brandenkrois."
Yamato: "The name of the Zigrim Republic's capital, meow."
Ymir: "I'm back. Have you been good?"
Touya: "H-Hey, don't cling to my arm. I can barely move."
Kururu: "It's fine. Touya and I are that close."
Forzen: "Oh, everyone. So this is where you were.
Touya, is that young lady your girlfriend?"
Touya: "Hey, hey. Oh, she's just saying that on her own,
Arthur: "My, my. What a heartbreaker you are."
Yamato: "She knocked you right out of the way."
Emy: "Hey! You said it again! Grr!"
Fain: "Aah! You really do get on my nerves!"
Ivel: "...I see. You certainly went through a great deal.
But it is thanks to all your efforts that York
has safely set out on the road to reconstruction."
Emy: "Exactly! It's all thanks to Big Sister's power!"
Ivel: "Now, now. You're making Ymir uncomfortable, aren't you?
Stop hanging on to her and let go."
Emy: "Hey! Did you just snort at me?!"
Forzen: "Well, let us leave those two aside..."
Um, Lady Ivel. About the current situation..."
Ivel: "I have heard from His Highness.
At present, there are no notable movements from the Zigrim Army.
You cannot be entirely at ease, but there is no need
for you to be quite so tense. In fact, Agarthia seems to be pushing
For now, please take your time and rest."
Clovis: "Whew... So we can catch our breath a little."
Ymir: "About this perfume you gave me, Lady Ivel...
told me to take good care of it...
I didn't think anything of it at the time, but
now that we know he is ≪Ze=Ode≫,
it has been bothering me a little...
Besides, when I'm surrounded by this scent, I feel somehow calmer...
Does this perfume have some meaning?"
Ivel: "...'Lacrima' is a flower that grows only
in certain regions and cannot be produced
Perhaps that is what he meant.
There is no need to think deeply about it."
Ivel: "Let us bring up the image."
Fain: "You're so noisy, Second. I can see that."
Emy: "I... told... you... Stop calling me Second!!"
Ymir: "...Only the Eleana has yet to appear,
but it seems certain that five mechs have been revived..."
Ymir: (All? But aren't there supposed to be six mechs in total...?)
Emy: "Oh, another one! This time it's the Gaiozon!"
Emy: "If you do nothing but charge in,
no number of lives will ever be enough for you."
Fain: "Hmph! I don't need you to tell me that, Second!"
Ai: "Hmm... So that's how this is going..."
Xiujian: "In any case, standing around here will achieve nothing."
Touya: "Yeah, you're right. All right! Spirit Mechs, launch!"
